message.content:
<think>The user wants to add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

Tomorrow's date is not specified, so I need to determine what "tomorrow" means. I'll assume the user means the next calendar day from the current date. The current date is January 15, 2025, so tomorrow would be January 16, 2025.

The meeting details:
- Title: "Marketing team meeting" (or similar)
- Start time: 2 PM tomorrow (January 16, 2025 at 2:00 PM)
- Duration: 1 hour (60 minutes)
- Location: "Main conference room"
- Attendees: "marketing team" (though this is vague - I'll just include the email/contact if provided, which it wasn't)

Let me create the event with these parameters.
</think>
